feeds.title: Books from Scotland
feeds.description: At Books from Scotland, we feel that we are best representing the literature of Scotland when we are most effectively engaging people in those ideas and stories, in the diversity of landscapes, characters, themes and voices which have grown out of, or been influenced by, these shores. Scotland has a long, illustrious history of originating creative thought, and we believe the conversation is well served by the books which come out of this country.

feeds.title: Floris Books Blog
feeds.description: At Floris Books, we see the world a little differently. Our adult non-fiction books cover all aspects of holistic and alternative living, including holistic health, organics and the environment, holistic education, mind body spirit, child health and development, self-help, religion and spirituality, and community living.

feeds.title: Chapter In My Life
feeds.description: Hi and welcome to Chapter In My Life - my blog about all things books! My name is Sharon. I am a Scottish Blogger with a particular interest and love of Scottish Crime Fiction. I read daily and on average devour 2/3 books per week (more if time permits). In particular I love Crime/thrillers/police procedurals and especially Scottish Crime Fiction

feeds.title: The Book Lover's Boudoir
feeds.description: I'm Pamela and I live in the UK with my partner.I love books and write fiction and poetry.This site will review books I own, borrow from the library, and review copies and copies from NetGalley.

feeds.title: Kelly Lacey & Love Books Tours
feeds.description: My name is Kelly and I am the founder of Love Books Group. I also organise book blog tours for authors. I take all the hard work out of promoting your books with a range of tours to choose from.

feeds.title: Portobello Book Blog by Joanne
feeds.description: I'm Joanne and I'm passionate about reading! I enjoy a wide variety of books but would say my favourite genres are contemporary fiction, historical fiction and I also enjoy a good love story. I really like uplifting and feel good books. I enjoy hearing about what others are reading and sharing what I have enjoyed reading.

feeds.title: CILIPS » SLG Scotland Blog
feeds.description: At the Chartered Institute of Library and Information Professionals in Scotland, we believe that libraries and quality information are essential in Scotland, now more than ever. Our vision is of a nation where the vital value of library and information professionals is recognised everywhere, and where our members are empowered to continue developing their innovative skills and knowledge.

feeds.title: Waverley Books Blog and News
feeds.description: The Gresham Publishing Company Limited is an independent Scottish book publishing company, based on the south side of Glasgow, Scotland UK. In 2007 G&G developed a second publishing list called Waverley Books, which focused on Scottish titles.

feeds.title: Life With All The Books
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Christine, I'm 29 years old and live in Scotland. I have always loved reading and I really want to share my love of books with likeminded people, this seemed like the best way to go about that. This site will primarily involve book reviews and 'best of' lists. I read most genres of books, however some more than others. I read a great deal of crime and thrillers, literary fiction, contemporary fiction, memoirs and a little mystery.

feeds.title: Maggie Craig Blog
feeds.description: Passionate about her native Scotland and its history, Maggie Craig is the acclaimed writer of the ground-breaking Damn' Rebel Bitches: The Women of the '45, its companion volume Bare-Arsed Banditti: The Men of the '45, When the Clyde Ran Red and One Week in April: The Scottish Radical Rising of 1820. She is also the author of six family saga novels set in Glasgow & Clydebank, where she grew up.

feeds.title: Gail Anthea Brown
feeds.description: My name is Gail and I'm an author, blogger and freelance writer from Caithness in the far north of Scotland. I love writing, reading, the simple life and home. I write books and articles inspired by place, people, and a deep sense of connection to my homeland.

feeds.title: National Library of Scotland Blog
feeds.description: A blog about the work and collections of the National Library of Scotland. From our curators, subject experts and guest bloggers. National Library of Scotland is a treasure trove of Scotland's knowledge, history, and culture with collections on every subject.

feeds.title: Creative Scotland Literature
feeds.description: Find all things Scotland Literature by Creative Scotland Literature.

feeds.title: Stromness Books And Prints Blog
feeds.description: Scotland's only drive-in bookshop. Just like a cat, you never really own a bookshop, and the people who have cared for this bookshop have been Charles Senior, John Broom, Tam MacPhail and the current handler Sheena.

feeds.title: Cornflower Books
feeds.description: Cornflower Books is all about books and the wider world of books: writing, publishing, literary festivals and prizes, bookshops, libraries, our reading habits, and more. It reflects my interests as a reader, its aim is to spread the word about good writing and books worth reading, and it functions as a source of recommendations, bookish news and comment, a place where good books of many types and vintages may be found and discussed.
